explanations.text: Team Spirit holds a substantial Elo advantage (~105 points) and a much stronger pre-event form (8W-4L vs 4W-8L). Both teams have shown similar 4-2 records at TI 2026, but Spirit's individual player quality is higher (Yatoro 855 GPM, Collapse on Underlord undefeated). Spirit has an H2H edge (1-0 at BLAST SLAM VII) and the Miposhka coaching addition brings veteran in-game leadership. Spirit's bans directly target IW's most-picked heroes (Keeper of the Light x12, Largo x11, Lone Druid x9). IW has shown they can compete, but Spirit is the clear favorite. Estimating Spirit ~62% to win, with 2-0 more likely than typical given Spirit's quality edge.

Team Spirit enters as the higher-rated, more experienced side with stronger pre-event form, but Iron Wing has shown comparable TI results and a clear early-game edge. I model Iron Wing as a competitive underdog with roughly a 0.40 map win rate, which makes Team Spirit the series favorite while still giving Iron Wing a realistic path, primarily in a three-map win.

Team Spirit is a clear but not overwhelming favorite: a strong Elo edge (1404 vs 1300), much better pre-event form, and the one all-time H2H win all point toward Spirit. Iron Wing’s current TI form is better than their rating suggests, with a 4-2 series record, 10-6 maps, and substantially stronger team gold/XP differentials at this event, so I cap Spirit’s edge. I estimate Team Spirit’s per-map win probability near 60%.

Elo gap (~105 points, Spirit #16 vs IW #54) makes Spirit the favorite, and their pedigree (Yatoro/Larl/Collapse core plus Miposhka's return as second coach) backs it. However, event data narrows the edge: Iron Wing is 4W-2L with 10-6 maps and dominant phase stats (+1792 gold @20min, +1898 XP @20min), while Spirit is 4W-2L with negative average gold/XP diffs and two 0:2 collapses to mid-tier teams. Iron Wing has never been swept at the event (both losses 1:2), so Spirit wins skew toward 2:1, while IW's upset path is more likely 2:1 than 2:0 against a stronger opponent. Net: Spirit ~63% series, IW ~37%.

Team Spirit holds a clear edge: ~105 Elo advantage (rank #16 vs #54), stronger pre-event form (8-4 vs 4-8), the only H2H win, and the addition of Miposhka as second coach for the playoff run. Iron Wing's TI run has been respectable (4-2 series) with genuinely strong gold differentials (+1792 @20), so they are live underdogs who can take a map — Spirit's event gold numbers are skewed by two 0:2 blowout losses to Vision and Nigma, while in their wins Spirit dominates (+2268 @20). Both teams play long games (~47 min) with volatile, high-variance profiles, so a 3-map series is quite plausible. I model Spirit at roughly a 61% per-map edge, giving them about 66% to win the series with the modal outcome being Spirit 2:1.

Team Spirit holds a ~104-point Elo edge, far superior pedigree (932W-633L, TI-winning core of Yatoro/Larl/Collapse), better pre-event form (8-4 vs 4-8), and won the only H2H. Iron Wing is genuinely hot at TI (4-2, 10-6 maps, strong early games: +520@10/+1792@20) and even beat Nigma 2:0 while Spirit lost 0:2 to them, so this is no blowout. Spirit's negative gold differentials mask a comeback-oriented style (won 2 of 6 when trailing 2k+ @15), and IW has blown big leads (1-of-2 when up 5k+ @15). Spirit's fixed ban priorities (KotL, Largo) align perfectly with what opponents target-ban against Iron Wing, a quiet draft edge, plus Miposhka's addition to the booth. Net: Spirit ~59% to take the series, with most outcomes landing 2:1 either way given both teams' long, grindy games.

Team Spirit holds a clear Elo edge (1404 vs 1299) and won the only prior H2H, but Iron Wing's TI run shows strong early-game metrics (first blood avg 0:42, positive gold diffs) and a 10-6 map record. Modeling Iron Wing per-map win probability at ~0.42 yields a ~38% series win chance; BO3 exact scores derived via binomial approximation.
Team Spirit's higher elo, all-time H2H win, and added coaching brain favor them despite Iron Wing's solid TI group stage; model estimates IW map win prob 0.43, yielding ~60% TS series win.

This is a close matchup between Iron Wing (Elo 1300) and Team Spirit (Elo 1404, ~105-point gap). Spirit has the better pre-event form (8W-4L vs 4W-8L) and just added Miposhka as second coach. However, Iron Wing has been more impressive at TI itself — they beat Nigma 2:0 (which crushed Spirit 0:2) and Falcons 2:1, while Spirit's two TI losses were both 0:2 sweeps. Spirit's losses were dominated while Iron Wing's losses (1:2 vs BoomBoys/Liquid) were close. Net: I give Spirit a modest edge (53%) based on Elo and pre-event form, but Iron Wing's TI resilience against strong opponents is real. The market price of Spirit +1.5 at 1.32 is too short given Spirit only sweeps ~23% of the time, and Spirit ML at 2.00 has a small edge over implied 50%.

Iron Wing has the stronger event-level early game by a clear margin (gold/XP diffs, first-blood timing), a better TI map record (10-6 vs 8-6), and their two losses were competitive 1-2 results rather than 0-2 blowouts. Team Spirit has the higher Elo and pedigree, but I still rate Iron Wing a narrow favorite and see value on their series win and clean-sweep line.

Spirit is the stronger side on the underlying metrics: +104 Elo, a TI-winning core, 8-4 pre-event form vs Iron Wing's 4-8, a 1-0 H2H, and the return of Miposhka as second coach. The market's coin-flip odds look like recency bias from Spirit's two 0:2 group-stage losses and Iron Wing's hot run/sweep of GamerLegion. Iron Wing's superior event gold/xp differentials warrant respect, but they don't outweigh the class gap, so I price Spirit around 57% per map and roughly 60% to win the series.

This is close to a pick'em for me despite Team Spirit's big Elo edge (1404 vs 1300) and TI pedigree: Spirit's event data is shaky (negative net gold/XP differentials, back-to-back 0:2 losses to TEAM VISION and Nigma, a new pos4 in not_me, Yatoro's Drow only 2W-3L), while Iron Wing arrive in better current form (10-6 maps, +4447 gold @30min, 6W-1L on their Earth Spirit flex, first blood ~0:42, competitive even in losses at -1728 vs Spirit's -8078). Blending Spirit's class edge with Iron Wing's form and draft-comfort edge, I get Iron Wing as a marginal ~53% series favorite with near-flat score distribution. Every menu item's implied probability sits at or above my own numbers (IW ML 0.526 implied vs 0.53 mine is a ~zero edge; the handicaps are worse), so nothing clears the value bar.

Team Spirit holds a significant Elo edge (1404 vs 1300), superior all-time pedigree (932W-633L), and the addition of Miposhka as second coach. Yatoro and Collapse are proven TI winners. However, Iron Wing has shown strong event form (4-2 series, positive gold/XP differentials, fast first bloods) and hasn't been swept at this TI. Spirit's two 0:2 losses at the event reveal vulnerability to focused game plans. IW's early-game snowball (+1050 gold @10 in wins) can pressure TS, whose overall event differentials are slightly negative. Still, Spirit's higher skill ceiling, deeper hero pool, and experience in high-pressure BO3s give them a clear but not overwhelming edge.

Team Spirit holds a ~105 Elo advantage and superior pre-event form (8W-4L vs 4W-8L), plus the Miposhka coaching addition for playoff experience. However, Iron Wing's TI event metrics are markedly stronger: positive aggregate gold/XP diffs (+520/@10, +1792/@20) versus Spirit's near-zero-to-negative figures, a better map record (10-6 vs 8-6), and a much faster first-blood average (0:42 vs 2:08). Spirit were swept 0:2 twice at this event, revealing fragility. Balancing Elo/experience pedigree against in-event performance, I estimate roughly 47% per-map win probability for Iron Wing, giving Spirit a modest series edge. The market prices Spirit at 2.00 (implied 50%), slightly below my ~54.5% assessment, creating a small value window on the Spirit moneyline.

Team Spirit has a roughly 105-point Elo advantage, stronger pre-event form, and a deeper historical baseline. Iron Wing's equal 4-2 TI series record, superior 10-6 map differential, strong recent sweep, and equal rest keep the matchup competitive, but Spirit remains a moderate favorite with meaningful sweep potential.

Team Spirit’s substantially higher Elo, stronger pre-event record, elite historical baseline, and coaching depth make it a modest series favorite. Iron Wing’s 4-2 TI run, 10-6 map record, stronger early-game metrics, and effective Earth Spirit/Kez results keep the matchup competitive and make a sweep less likely.

Team Spirit retain a modest edge from the 104-point Elo advantage, stronger pre-event record, and the lone prior H2H win. Iron Wing's equally strong 4-2 TI series record, superior map differential, and much better event gold/XP profile narrow that gap and support a meaningful chance of extending the series, but Spirit remain the favorite.

Both teams enter this UB quarterfinal at 4-2 in their last six series at TI 2026. Iron Wing's wins include a strong 2:1 vs Team Falcons plus clean 2:0s over Nigma and GamerLegion; their losses (BoomBoys, Team Liquid) were both close 1:2 series. Team Spirit's wins feature a quality 2:1 over Team Liquid but their losses were worrying — a 0-2 stomp (7-37 kills) vs TEAM VISION and a tight 0-2 vs Nigma. Iron Wing's wax/wings anchors the highest-WR tournament hero (Earth Spirit 66%) and the roster looks more consistent in their recent finishes (2:0 vs GamerLegion as the last series). Spirit has a quality core but showed a volatility problem. I narrowly favor Iron Wing in a BO3 with significant chance of three maps.

Iron Wing (core of ex-Tundra: Pure, bzm, 33, Ari, Whitemon) entered as an invite, finished group 3-2 with a 2-0 over Nigma and closed out the elimination round with a 2-0 sweep of GamerLegion. Team Spirit (Yatoro/Larl/Collapse, with new pos4 'not me' since May and Miposhka back as coach) also went 3-2 in groups but lost their final two group series 0-2 (to TEAM VISION and Nigma) before scraping by Team Resilience 2-1 in elimination, showing instability. Transitive results (Iron Wing 2-0 Nigma, Nigma 2-0 Spirit) and the Esports Insider playoff power ranking (Iron Wing 4th, Spirit 7th) favor Iron Wing; I model Iron Wing as a ~58% per-map favorite in a BO3.

Iron Wing (ex-Tundra core of Pure/bzm/33/Ari/Whitemon) enters as a directly-invited powerhouse with dominant group-stage wins — a 30-5 sweep of Nigma and a clinical 2-0 over GamerLegion — and strong meta fit (Earth Spirit, Kez, Necrophos, Windranger). Spirit's two-time TI champion core beat Liquid 2-1 but collapsed on Aug 15 with back-to-back 0-2 losses to TEAM VISION and Nigma (whom Iron Wing swept), and needed three maps plus survived a 54-21 blowout against Resilience. Common-opponent results split (Iron Wing better vs Nigma, Spirit better vs Liquid), and Spirit's playoff pedigree keeps it close, but Iron Wing's cohesion, form and draft alignment make them a moderate favorite.

Both teams enter 4-2 overall, but the evidence tilts to Iron Wing. Common opponents favor IW strongly: they swept Nigma Galaxy 2-0 (a 4-1 group winner) while Spirit lost 0-2 to both Nigma and top seed TEAM VISION; IW's only losses were tight 1-2 series vs Liquid and BoomBoys, while Spirit showed high volatility (a 49-23 stomp of Liquid but 7-37 and 21-54 blowout losses to VISION and Team Resilience, plus a dropped map in the elimination round vs a 2-3 team that IW swept). IW's 8-6 game record with wins over Nigma/Falcons suggests better map-level consistency, and they lean on tournament-warping Earth Spirit (66% WR) that Spirit repeatedly has banned away or suffered against. I set IW's per-map edge at ~0.54, yielding a modest series lean.

Spirit's higher Elo and stronger pre-event series form keep this close, but Iron Wing's 10-6 TI map record and substantially better average 20-minute gold and XP differentials indicate the stronger current-event game state. With equal rest, Iron Wing gets a narrow series edge, while the conflicting baseline and event signals limit confidence.

Team Spirit have a modest edge from the 104-point Elo gap, stronger pre-event form, and Miposhka's addition to the coaching staff. Iron Wing's 10-6 TI map record and substantially better early-to-midgame differentials make the matchup much closer, while Spirit's consecutive 0-2 losses limit confidence. With equal rest and no event H2H, Spirit are narrow favorites in a series likely to reach three maps.

Iron Wing's lower Elo and weaker pre-event record are narrowly outweighed by its stronger TI performance, including a 10-6 map record, superior phase differentials and valuable Earth Spirit flexibility. Team Spirit retains substantial upside through its experienced core and Miposhka's coaching return, but its two 0-2 event losses create meaningful sweep risk.

Team Spirit enters the series as favorites based on their significantly higher Elo ranking, championship pedigree, and historical head-to-head edge, bolstered by Miposhka's coaching presence. However, Iron Wing (featuring veterans Pure and 33) has displayed superior in-game resource metrics and solid group performance at this event, giving them a reasonable shot to take maps in a contested series.

Iron Wing and Team Spirit both entered the upper bracket 4-2 in TI2026 series, but Iron Wing closed on a 2-series win streak (2:1 vs Yandex, 2:0 vs GamerLegion) while Spirit was swept twice before rebounding 2:1 vs Resilience. Iron Wing's recent map win rate (10/16=0.625) slightly exceeds Spirit's (8/14=0.571) and they hold momentum; no head-to-head exists. Estimating Iron Wing per-map win probability at ~0.53 yields a modest series edge.

Both squads arrive at the Upper Bracket Quarterfinals with 4-2 group stage records and demonstrated high-level execution. Iron Wing boasts superior early-to-mid game phase metrics (+1792 gold diff at 20m) driven by 33's tempo leadership and bzm's active playmaking. However, Team Spirit features superior peak carry efficiency through Yatoro (855 GPM) and proven playoff resilience under the dual guidance of Miposhka and MiLAN. Given Spirit's higher baseline Elo balanced against Iron Wing's sharper map differential at this tournament, this matchup projects as an exceptionally close, three-map-leaning contest with no decisive betting edge at current market lines.

Both sides are 4-2 with contradictory transitive results (Iron Wing swept Nigma, who swept Spirit; Spirit beat Liquid, who beat Iron Wing), making this near a coin flip. I give Iron Wing a slight edge because their losses were all tight 1:2 series (they consistently take maps) versus Spirit's two 0:2 sweeps that signal fragility, plus Iron Wing's strong Earth Spirit-centric form in their final 2:0. I model Iron Wing at ~0.52 per-map, yielding a ~0.53 series win probability.

No TI H2H is available. Iron Wing, the former Tundra/1w roster of Pure, bzm, 33, Ari and Whitemon, is 4-2 over its last six TI series, 10-6 in maps and just swept GamerLegion; Spirit is also 4-2 but 8-6, with two 0-2 losses before a 2-1 recovery over Resilience. Iron's recurring Earth Spirit/Lina/Storm and Kez/Windranger combinations fit the strongest tournament meta signals, but Team Spirit's Yatoro/Larl/Collapse/not me/rue lineup and greater playoff pedigree make this near-even with a small Spirit edge.

Iron Wing's 10-6 TI map run includes wins over Nigma and Falcons plus a 2-0 elimination sweep, and its flexible Earth Spirit, Kez, and Lina drafts fit the strongest 7.41e signals. Spirit showed its ceiling in a 2-1 win over Liquid, but then went 0-4 against VISION and Nigma before needing three maps against Resilience; its May support reshuffle remains a cohesion risk. With no tournament H2H, Iron Wing is a modest favorite rather than a decisive one.

Iron Wing has the stronger tournament body of work: a 10-6 map record against a tougher slate, including series wins over Nigma, Falcons, and Yandex, while Spirit is 8-6 and went 3-5 across its last eight maps. Iron Wing's established former-Tundra lineup and 6-1 record when drafting Earth Spirit, flexed between bzm and 33, provide a cohesion and draft edge. Spirit's championship core and its own strong Earth Spirit execution preserve substantial upset potential, but the newer support setup looked volatile in losses to TEAM VISION and Nigma; there is no tournament H2H.

Iron Wing (ex-Tundra roster featuring Pure, bzm, and 33) showed greater overall consistency through the Swiss stage (10-5 map record, taking down Falcons 2-1 and sweeping Nigma 2-0). Team Spirit (8-7 map record) displayed a high ceiling with wins over Liquid and Xtreme, but suffered clean 0-2 sweeps against TEAM VISION and Nigma due to draft and mid-game coordination vulnerabilities with their newer support duo. Iron Wing holds a slight structural and meta drafting edge in this Upper Bracket Quarterfinal.

Iron Wing (4-2 recent) edges Team Spirit (4-2) in form, no H2H, upper bracket QF. Spirit slight favorite on ML but Iron Wing strong on handicap; BO3 favors experience, meta neutral but Earth Spirit meta for Spirit. Probabilities adjusted for close series.

Team Spirit holds a clear edge with higher Elo (1404 vs 1299), superior all-time H2H record (1-0), and more experienced roster despite similar TI form records for both. This translates to ~60% series win probability for TSpirit in BO3 Upper Bracket QF, with series outcomes skewed toward close 1:2 or 0:2 results given matchup dynamics and draft overlap.

Team Spirit holds the edge via higher Elo (1404 vs 1299), superior pre-event form (8W-4L series vs IW's 4W-8L), and recent H2H win 1:0. Iron Wing shows strong Earth Spirit synergy and map edges in wins but is outclassed overall. Estimated TSpirit series win prob 60%, so higher weight on 1:2 and 0:2 outcomes.

Two elite teams in a near coin-flip. Iron Wing is the intact ex-Tundra roster (Pure, bzm, 33, Ari, Whitemon) with superior cohesion; Team Spirit has the higher individual peak via Yatoro (red-hot form) and the Yatoro/Collapse/Larl championship core, but is integrating a new support duo (not me, rue) after Miposhka moved to coaching. Both went 3-2 in the Swiss group stage and sit at adjacent seeds (Spirit 4th, Iron Wing 5th). Cross-results cancel: Iron Wing swept Nigma (who beat Spirit), but Spirit beat Liquid (who beat Iron Wing). I give Iron Wing a marginal edge (~0.52) on roster stability, with the series likely competitive and often going to a third map.

Near coin-flip upper-bracket BO3. Both teams finished the group/elimination stage 4-2; no H2H at TI2026. Iron Wing is the higher seed, finished the group on a strong run (beat Nigma 2-0 who swept Spirit, Falcons 2-1, Yandex 2-1) and swept GamerLegion in the elimination round to qualify. Spirit's losses (VISION, Nigma) were 0-2 yet both 50+ min grinds, and their Yatoro/Larl/Collapse core plus a 2-1 win over Liquid keeps them right there. I price Iron Wing as a slight favorite (~53%) on seeding, momentum, and cross-results, but the edge over the near-even market price is thin.

Near coin-flip between two 3-2 Swiss teams that both survived the elimination round. Iron Wing is the ex-Tundra core (Pure, bzm, 33, Ari, Whitemon, coach MoonMeander) with elite pedigree and good current form (wins over Nigma 2-0, Falcons 2-1, Yandex, GamerLegion; only losses to Liquid 1-2 and BoomBoys). Team Spirit still fields Yatoro/Larl/Collapse but with two new supports (rue, not me) after Miposhka moved to coaching; they beat Liquid 2-1 but slumped 0-2 to VISION and Nigma (both close hour-long games vs Nigma). Cross-comparisons cancel out: Spirit's Liquid win vs Iron Wing's Nigma 2-0. Iron Wing's roster stability, coaching and momentum give them a slight edge, roughly 53/47. Versus best prices, only Iron Wing ML at 1.90 offers a marginal edge over implied probability; handicaps and Spirit ML are fairly priced or worse.

Both teams are 4-2 in their last 6 series. Iron Wing (1w Team) shows a stable roster playing top meta heroes (Earth Spirit 66% wr, Hoodwink, Mirana, Necrophos, Undying, Ember, Kez), and won their last two series (2:1 vs Yandex, 2:0 vs GamerLegion). Team Spirit had concerning 0-2 losses to VISION and Nigma before bouncing back 2:1 vs Resilience, and field a less stable roster (pos 4 'not me' joined May 2026, coaches Miposhka/MiLAN joined June 2026) with somewhat off-meta drafts (Terrorblade/Jakiro). Slight edge to Iron Wing due to meta fit and form, but the bookmaker prices (IW 1.90, Spirit 2.00) are very fair and no market item has meaningful value.

Iron Wing is the ex-Tundra roster (Pure, bzm, 33, Ari, Whitemon, MoonMeander) and has been the steadier team at TI15: 4-2 in Swiss, never swept, and a dominant 2:0 closeout over GamerLegion, with quality wins over Nigma and Falcons. Spirit's core (Yatoro, Larl, Collapse) beat Liquid 2:1, but their rebuilt support duo (not me, rue) posted poor individual lines in back-to-back 0:2 sweeps by TEAM VISION and Nigma on Aug 15. Both finished group stage adjacent (Spirit 13 pts, Iron Wing 12 pts), so this is close to a coin flip, but Iron Wing's consistency, 33's drafting, and support stability give them a moderate edge (~55% series win).

Near coin-flip UB opener: identical 4W-2L/9-5 records, but IW enters with better event form (wins over UB-caliber Nigma/Falcons/Yandex, 2:0 stomp to close) while Spirit lost 0:2 twice late. Season-long class, 6-1 org H2H, the Liquid common-opponent edge and vastly deeper TI playoff pedigree tip me slightly to Spirit (~0.52), making Spirit ML at 2.00 thin value and +1.5 marginally +EV.

Iron Wing has the stronger recent form (won 3 of last 4; beat Nigma Galaxy 2:0 while Team Spirit lost 0:2 to that same Nigma) and enters on a two-series win streak, whereas Spirit dropped two ugly 0:2 sweeps (including vs lower-tier VISION) before a 2:1 over Resilience. Both are 4-2 at TI, but Iron Wing's comparative results and momentum give a slight edge. Given Spirit's all-or-nothing recent pattern (swept when losing, sweeps when winning) I model the most likely outcome as an Iron Wing 2:1, with a real chance of either side sweeping. Market (~1.90 Iron Wing) aligns with a small Iron Wing edge.

Both teams went 4-2 in groups. Iron Wing were more consistent (both losses 1:2, closed with a 2:0 sweep of GamerLegion and a 2:0 of the Nigma side that swept Spirit) with strong meta drafts (Lina/Kez/Undying). Spirit showed a higher peak (2:0 vs Xtreme and Aurora, 2:1 vs Liquid) but were swept twice mid-event before a shaky 2:1 recovery. Liquid holds the edge on Elo (#4 vs #8), event form (4-1 vs 3-3), rest, and especially common opponents at TI: Liquid beat Yandex, Aurora and Iron Wing while Yandex lost to both Aurora and Iron Wing, with Liquid's only loss a close 1:2 to Spirit. Liquid hold a modest but real edge: higher Elo (~37 pts), better TI form (4-1 series vs 3-3), and a 2:1 win over Yandex six days ago. Liquid hold meaningful edges: higher Elo (+37), a 2:1 win over Yandex six days ago at this event, better TI form (4-1 vs 3-3), and one extra rest day. Liquid have a modest edge from their higher Elo, 4-1 TI series record, direct 2-1 win, and stronger mid-to-late-game conversion. Yandex's superior early-game numbers, broad hero pool, and strong prior form should keep the rematch competitive, limiting Liquid's sweep probability.
